display.purpose: The current service name in the hero only. Uppercase.

headline.purpose: Section headings in the left column, uppercase; up to 4.5rem for the closing ask.

title.purpose: Card titles on the photo, uppercase; scales by card size.

numeral.purpose: Stub prices and the hero slide number, tabular.

lead.purpose: Section intros and the hero summary.

label.purpose: Ticket stub duration and currency line. Not for eyebrows above headings.

wordmark.purpose: The logo's Cinzel voice; footer column heads and tagline only.

motion.name: slide-interval
motion.purpose: Hero autoplay interval; the gold progress line fills linearly over it.

motion.name: slide-handover
motion.value: clip-path inset(card rect round 6px) -> inset(0 round 0), 950ms cubic-bezier(0.7, 0, 0.2, 1)
motion.purpose: The chosen queue card grows into the full-bleed background. Back steps crossfade 700ms ease-out. Instant under reduced motion.

motion.name: queue-flip
motion.value: animate:flip 700ms; enter fade 500ms (300ms delay); leave fade 250ms
motion.purpose: The queue sliding along on each step.

motion.name: hero-drift
motion.purpose: Slow settling zoom on the current hero photo. Off under reduced motion.

motion.name: copy-swap
motion.purpose: Hero name and summary changing with the slide.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: GSAP from y 36px, opacity 0, 1s power3.out, stagger 0.06-0.1, once at top 85%
motion.purpose: Section fade-up. Content stays visible until GSAP loads.

narrative.overview:
Uganda's journeys are shown as photography that fills the screen, with the place's name set huge in condensed capitals over it. The card is the photo itself: name, place and a short gold dash sit on the picture under a dark scrim. Forest green carries the brand between photographs, in sections that alternate forest-950 and forest-900. The stamp heritage of the earlier iteration survives only as one-sided details: a perforated left edge on the hero's queued cards, a perforated paper ticket stub along the bottom of tour cards, and circular postmarks for provenance.

The homepage opens on a full-bleed service slider that plays through every published service on its own: the current service's name and actions on the left, the services coming up queued on the right as portrait photo cards running off the screen edge, and below them round previous/next buttons, pause, a gold progress line and a big slide number. On each step the first queued card grows from its own rectangle into the background. Controls are pills and round icon buttons. Nothing casts a shadow. Everything is visible before JavaScript arrives; first-paint motion is CSS, later motion is transform and opacity, plus the clip-path handover.

Scope: this system covers the public website. The dashboard keeps the stock shadcn-svelte tokens (stone base, maia style, `--radius` 0.875rem) in the same stylesheet; do not mix the two. The older page heroes (tours, services, blog, contact, about) set in Cinzel with eyebrows, the PlanCta panel, the inquiry form's white rounded panel, white rounded content cards with soft shadows on detail pages, the gradient PriceTag, and the blog postcard are legacy awaiting migration, not part of the system. Confirmed visual rejections: boxed white cards, stacked badges, icon grids, price-led heroes, the booking-portal look and the clinical hospital look.
keyCharacteristics: Full-bleed photographs under dark scrims; the photo is the card.
Oswald condensed uppercase for every name, heading and numeral; Montserrat for reading.
A short gold dash above every title.
Pill buttons and round icon buttons; one gold progress line.
White paper only on one side of a card (the ticket stub), never framing a photo.
Flat: no shadows. Gradients only as photo scrims and the 1px gold rule.

rules.name: The Gold-On-Forest Rule
rules.body: Gold sits on forest or on scrimmed photos only. On paper and cream, prices and active marks are forest text, with gold allowed only as a 2px underline.

rules.name: The Single Duty Rule
rules.body: WhatsApp green appears only on WhatsApp actions; crane red only as tiny accents and error text.

rules.name: The Condensed Caps Rule
rules.body: Anything that is a name (a service, a place, a journey, a section) or a big number is Oswald uppercase. Anything read as a sentence, and every control label, is Montserrat.

rules.name: The Wordmark Stays Put Rule
rules.body: Cinzel is the logo's voice. Outside the logo it appears only in the footer column heads and tagline; it is not a heading face for new surfaces.

rules.name: The Scrim-Only Gradient Rule
rules.body: Gradients exist to make type readable over photographs, plus the 1px gold rule. Never a gradient fill on a button, badge or surface.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow. A card stands forward because it is a photograph on forest.

rules.name: The One Paper Side Rule
rules.body: White paper touches a card on one side only: the perforated ticket stub along the bottom of a tour card. Paper never frames a photo on all sides.

dos: Do let the photograph be the card: title, dash and meta on the photo under a bottom scrim.
Do set names, headings and big numbers in Oswald uppercase with tight leading (0.92 to 0.95), and mark every title with a short gold dash.
Do alternate forest-950 and forest-900 between sections.
Do use pills for worded buttons and circles for icon buttons; pair "Plan my trip" with WhatsApp on every closing ask.
Do keep white paper to one side of a card, the perforated ticket stub, carrying duration and the "from" price.
Do use the postmark for provenance (place and month).
Do keep photographs at their true aspect in justified rows with 3px gaps.
Do animate only transform, opacity and clip-path handovers; land first-paint motion with CSS; let any autoplay pause on hover, focus and hidden tabs, and offer a pause button.
donts: Don't use shadows; depth is photography and tonal forest.
Don't use gradients except photo scrims and the 1px gold rule.
Don't frame a photo in white paper on all sides, or build boxed white cards.
Don't put eyebrow or kicker text above headings; the gold dash is the only mark above a title.
Don't set gold text on paper or cream.
Don't use WhatsApp green for anything but WhatsApp actions, or crane red beyond tiny accents and errors.
Don't lead a hero with a price, or add stacked badges, ratings, urgency labels or icon grids.
Don't use Cinzel as a heading face on new surfaces, or shadcn-svelte components and dashboard tokens on public pages.
